Implementation pushed as Gerrit change 1942 (commit 39e2ea3b52, branch b0a5-lifecycle-collisions off origin/main e278425d7a).

MECHANISM CONFIRMED IN CODE (not taken on faith): scripts/gen_config_reference.py::_lifecycle_index had TWO index.setdefault(replacement, ...) calls — one over _cfg_deprecations(), one over _cfg_tombstones(). First-wins, so a second alias/tombstone aimed at the same canonical replacement key was silently discarded. Sole consumer is _schema_rows() -> the Lifecycle table cell.

NO LIVE COLLISION today, verified by enumerating the registry: cfg deprecations = [verify.overlap_enabled -> verify.suggest_duplicate_tickets]; cfg tombstones = [verify.require_verdict_for_close -> verify.require_completion_verification_for_close] plus six with empty replacement. Collision count = 0. Defensive fix, as the plan says.

RED FIRST: both new guards were run against the UNMODIFIED generator and failed for the right reason — the first note rendered and the second was absent, e.g.
  AssertionError: second alias note dropped from 'code_health.include_extensions' row: | `code_health.include_extensions` | `list[str]` | `[]` | active — supersedes alias `legacy.first_alias` (permanent alias) |
That is the drop itself, not an unrelated error. After the fix: 14 passed.

GENERATED DOCS: none needed regenerating. The single-note case renders byte-identically ('active — ' + the one note), so python scripts/gen_config_reference.py --check exits 0 against the committed tree and git status shows no doc modification. docs/env-vars.md is also unaffected — its generator scans DEFAULT_SCAN_ROOT = src/rebar only, and python scripts/gen_env_registry.py --check exits 0.

GATES: make lint PASS; make typecheck PASS (576 files); python scripts/check_complexity_baseline.py --check run DIRECTLY -> 'active=49 new=0 increased=0 stale=0' exit 0. .github/complexity-baseline.json untouched.
